title: 2026-11-17_Sofacy_Fysbis_Backdoor_Investigation_c07
description: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a compromised Linux host that appears to be infected with the Sofacy Fysbis backdoor. Your goal is to identify and analyze the malicious activity, understand the backdoor's behavior, and take appropriate containment measures.
outcomes: Identify suspicious services and their associated ports.
Analyze systemd timers and services for persistence mechanisms.
Investigate lateral movement activities and file transfers.
Contain the threat by terminating malicious processes and disabling persistence mechanisms.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a compromised Linux host that appears to be infected with the Sofacy Fysbis backdoor. Your goal is to identify and analyze the malicious activity, understand the backdoor's behavior, and take appropriate containment measures.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Connect to the target host using SSH: `ssh cyrano@target`
levels.local_content: Connect to the target host using SSH: `ssh cyrano@target`

levels.title: Suspicious C2 Service Discovery
levels.content: Security monitoring has detected an unusual network-facing component on the compromised host. Investigate the running services and identify the service responsible for the suspicious activity.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the target host using SSH: `ssh cyrano@target`
2. List all services, including inactive ones: `systemctl list-units --type=service --all`
3. Look for unfamiliar or suspicious service names. Pay attention to services with unusual descriptions or those that are not part of standard system services.
4. Identify the suspicious service name.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use the following command to list all services, including inactive ones: `systemctl list-units --type=service --all`

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions that do not match standard system services.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Check the status of the suspicious service to gather more information: `systemctl status <service_name>`

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (Port)
levels.content: An unfamiliar network service appears to be involved in unauthorized communication with an external system. Investigate the service and determine the network port associated with this communication.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the target host using SSH: `ssh cyrano@target`
2. Check the status of the suspicious service identified in Task 1: `systemctl status systemkernelservicedefender.service`
3. Look for the port number in the ExecStart command. The port number is specified as an argument to the ncat command.
4. Verify the port is listening using the following command: `ss -tulnp | grep <port_number>`

levels.title: Persistence Discovery for Data Collection Service
levels.content: Investigators suspect that unauthorized activity automatically resumes after the system starts and continues to execute periodically. Determine which system component is responsible for scheduling this activity.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the target host using SSH: `ssh cyrano@target`
2. List all systemd timers to identify the component responsible for scheduling the unauthorized activity: `systemctl list-timers --all`
3. Look for timers associated with the suspicious service identified in Task 1.
4. Check the details of the identified timer to understand its scheduling mechanism: `systemctl cat <timer_name>`
